purpose: Teach: 島田/町田/森山/前原/足立/平山/椎名/村田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、島田氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Father — when you were young, you and Shimada-san started a joint venture together.
lines.style: Gentle, measuring cadence. Patient pause between clauses. The tone of someone curating a memory they want their son to understand, not merely to recount. Warm recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは町田先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father received excellent guidance from Machida-senpai.
lines.style: Humble acknowledgment. Slight bow in the voice on the opening. Measured, respectful. The tone of a son honoring what his father built, speaking across generations with quiet reverence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、森山氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: Father — in those early days, you and Moriyama-san planned the overseas expansion.
lines.style: Softer intonation. A touch of wistfulness, as if stepping back into time. Unhurried pacing. The voice of someone reflecting on a road taken, wondering at its choices.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは前原氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father positioned Maehara-san as the pillar of our public affairs.
lines.style: Steady, reflective cadence. Each name and role given its weight. Speaking with the clarity of hindsight. The quiet certainty of someone who lived through these decisions and sees now what they meant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、足立氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: Father — and in those years, you and Adachi-san built the accounting structure from the ground up.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. A gentle cataloguing. Pause before "accounting structure" — the gravity of the foundational work. Voice trails slightly at the end, inviting his son to complete the picture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは平山氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. Father developed Hirayama-san into a lead manager.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Steady, grounded delivery. The voice of someone who took the long view of people's growth. Each word placed with care. The confidence of a man who built things that lasted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、椎名氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Father — when you were establishing yourself, you and Shiina-san founded the overseas corporation.
lines.style: Tone deepens slightly. The final catalogue piece. Wistful but not melancholy. A man recognizing the arc of his father's accomplishments. Voice settles into the weight of legacy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは村田氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted all legal matters to Murata-san.
lines.style: Final reflection, calm and complete. Voice carries a sense of closure — the full picture now visible. Slow, dignified cadence. The tone of someone who has handed off the legacy and speaks of it now with earned wisdom.
